# Third-party source notices

`tree-sitter-typescript` 0.23.2 declares MIT but its published Cargo package's
`include` list excludes its upstream `LICENSE`. To include the actual copyright
notice in distributions, `licenses/tree-sitter-typescript-0.23.2/LICENSE` is an
unmodified copy from the package's exact `.cargo_vcs_info.json` revision
`f975a621f4e7f532fe322e13c4f79495e0a7b2e7`.

[Upstream license at that revision](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-typescript/blob/f975a621f4e7f532fe322e13c4f79495e0a7b2e7/LICENSE).
`license-overrides.json` records the crate checksum, source URL/revision and license
SHA-256. The release collector verifies all three identities before using the
copy. An upgraded crate requires a fresh review; this is not a blanket substitute
for missing licenses. No parser source is changed or vendored here.
